steps.text: Estimate quickly! Lock the option that is closest to the real population value.
Tap the estimate you think is nearest to the true number.
Watch the radar — the closer your lock, the higher you score.
Round each number to the same place, then compare — that's how you estimate fast.

coach.mission: Lock the estimate closest to the real value.
whenStuck: Tap the option nearest the true number.
Round each number to the same place, then compare.
whenWrong: Round to the same place first, then pick the closest — check which is nearer, above or below.
Estimate by the leading digits rather than the exact number.
coach.done: You can estimate large values fast now. Keep going, or move on.
